title: 12.21: a realm at its player limit queues the next wizard, which enters by itself when the first logs out
notes: Two clients on accounts of their own, as in two-wizards.json. The main wizard enters the Commons, then the realm's player_limit is set to 1 in the login database and read back on a one-second refresh.
The companion presses Play on the full realm and is queued at position 1; it is photographed twice while queued, to show what the client draws for MSG_CHARACTERSELECTED PrepPhase=1.
The main wizard quits from the in-world menu, its realm_online_character row goes, and the companion is sent to the realm with a fresh key without pressing anything, and stands in the Commons.
Opening the in-world menu asks for the privacy and PvP options, which no milestone answers yet.
server_log_allowed: character_create_school holds no school, so no wizard can be created until it does
realmlist holds no realm, so no player can be sent to a gameserver until one is added
